page: Microsoft Azure DS4 is a general-purpose virtual machine instance belonging to the DS family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features 8 dedicated physical cores and 8 vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8272CL x86_64 processor operating at a base frequency of 2.6 GHz. The processor configuration includes a 35 MB L3 cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 32 KB L1d cache. The instance is equipped with 28.0 GB of system memory, providing 3.5 GB of RAM per core, and includes 57 GB of local storage. No GPUs are bundled with this instance, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results indicate a clear performance profile characterized by average multi-core capabilities alongside weaker single-core execution. In single-core tests, such as stress-ng and Geekbench, the DS4 scores in the bottom 25% tier. This single-threaded limitation is also reflected in weak compression and decompression speeds, with gzip single-threaded compression reaching 21.28 GB/sec and bzip3 single-threaded decompression at 8.31 GB/sec. Conversely, multi-core benchmarks, including Geekbench multi-core (6121.0) and Passmark CPU (11056.47), place the instance in the middle 50% performance tier. Memory bandwidth is stable, with cached small-block read speeds of 720.11 GB/sec and uncached large-block write speeds of 43.54 GB/sec.

The DS4 offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads that benefit from multi-threaded execution rather than high single-core clock speeds. It demonstrates average performance in database operations, static web serving at 9.75 GB/sec, and Redis SET operations at 12.06 million operations per second. It is also capable of handling light machine learning tasks, processing 730.83 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M parameter LLM. Given its hardware profile, the instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for general-purpose enterprise applications, software compilation, and mid-tier database hosting where extreme single-thread performance is not a critical requirement.
